The total cost of the chicken meal, milk, and apples before adding the cost of pizza boxes can be calculated as follows:

2. Milk (5 packs at $3 each): \( 5 \times 3 = \$15 \)
3. Apples (4 at $1.50 each): \( 4 \times 1.50 = \$6 \)
